data.create_deletion_repair: Create a Repair issue when an entity is deleted

history_conflict.title: Entity history conflict: {entity_id}
history_conflict.description:
**Old Entity ID:** `{source_label}`  
**New Entity ID:** `{target_label}`

Old Entity History: **{source_measurements} measurements ({source_records} records) · {source_units}**  
New Entity History: **{unknown_target_measurements} measurements ({unknown_target_records} records) · {target_units}**

abort.already_resolved: This conflict has already been resolved or replaced by a newer entity rename.
abort.integration_not_loaded: Entity History Migrator is not currently loaded.

init.title: Resolve entity history conflict

merge.title: Confirm merge
merge.description:
This will migrate **{source_measurements} measurements ({source_records} records) · {source_units}** from:

`{source_label}`

to:

`{target_label}`

and merge them with **{unknown_target_measurements} existing measurements ({unknown_target_records} records) · {target_units}** already stored under that ID.

**The merged history will belong to this entity.**

delete.title: Confirm delete
delete.description:
This will delete **{unknown_target_measurements} measurements ({unknown_target_records} records) · {target_units}** currently stored under:

`{target_label}`

and migrate **{source_measurements} measurements ({source_records} records) · {source_units}** from:

`{source_label}`

to:

`{target_label}`

**This is destructive.** Press **Confirm** to proceed.

ignore.title: Confirm ignore
ignore.description:
This will ignore the conflict; both histories will remain unchanged.

**{source_measurements} measurements ({source_records} records) · {source_units}** under:

`{source_label}`

**{unknown_target_measurements} measurements ({unknown_target_records} records) · {target_units}** under:

`{target_label}`

custom.title: Rename historical data
custom.description:
Archive **{unknown_target_measurements} measurements ({unknown_target_records} records) · {target_units}** currently under:

`{target_label}`

as the Archive Entity ID entered below.

Then migrate **{source_measurements} measurements ({source_records} records) · {source_units}** from:

`{source_label}`

to:

`{target_label}`

The archive is verified before the original target history is deleted.

The Archive Entity ID must use the same domain and must not already exist in Home Assistant or have history in the configured backend.

confirm_custom.title: Confirm archive and migration
confirm_custom.description:
This will preserve **{unknown_target_measurements} measurements ({unknown_target_records} records) · {target_units}** under the archive ID:

`{custom_target_entity_id}`

and migrate **{source_measurements} measurements ({source_records} records) · {source_units}** from:

`{source_label}`

to:

`{target_label}`

The archive copy is verified before the existing target history is removed.

error.invalid_entity_id: Enter a valid Home Assistant entity ID, for example sensor.pc_hydra_voltage_history.
error.different_domain: The Archive Entity ID must use the same domain as the New Entity ID.
error.reserved_entity_id: Choose a different Archive Entity ID. The Old and New Entity IDs, and any known timeline aliases, cannot be used as the archive target.
error.entity_already_exists: That Entity ID already exists in Home Assistant. Choose an unused Archive Entity ID.
error.history_already_exists: InfluxDB already contains history under that Entity ID. Choose an unused Archive Entity ID.
error.cannot_check_custom_target: Could not verify that the Archive Entity ID is unused in the configured history backend. No decision was saved.

entity_deleted.title: Entity deleted: {entity_id}
entity_deleted.description:
`{entity_id}` was removed from the Home Assistant Entity Registry.

The migrator found **{measurement_count} historical measurements** in **{segment_count} proven ownership intervals**. The data has not been modified. Open this issue to decide whether to keep or delete the history.

abort.already_resolved: A decision for this deletion has already been recorded.
abort.integration_not_loaded: Entity History Migrator is not currently loaded.
abort.history_backend_unavailable: The configured history database could not be queried. No decision was saved.
abort.history_operation_failed: The history operation could not be completed or verified. The Repair issue remains available so you can retry.
abort.deletion_queued: The decision is queued. This Repair closes after the worker completes it.
abort.deletion_target_changed: The history database changed. Reopen this Repair to review the current history.
abort.deletion_write_disabled: This history database currently has deletion disabled.

init.title: Resolve deleted entity history
init.description:
**Deleted Entity ID:** `{entity_id}`

Proven history: **{measurement_count} measurements ({record_count} records)** across **{segment_count} ownership intervals**.

**Database history**  
{history_details}

**Proven ownership time range**  
    `{start}`  
to  
    `{stop}`

Only history whose ownership is proven by the migrator is included. Unknown or archived history is left untouched.

Choose whether to permanently delete this proven history or keep it and record that decision.

delete_history.title: Confirm deletion of historical data
delete_history.description:
This will permanently delete **{measurement_count} measurements ({record_count} records)** across **{segment_count} proven intervals** for:

`{entity_id}`

Proven history spans `{start}` to `{stop}`. Unknown or archived history is not included.

**This is destructive.** Press **Confirm** to proceed.

deletion_review.description:

keep_history.description:
